## Description

Finds files in the deposit that are larger than the size limit, so they are not committed to the Git repository.

- Copies `.gitignore` to `generated/dot-gitignore` and appends every file over the limit, with a dated comment.
- Writes the difference to `generated/diff-dot-gitignore.txt`.
- When large files exist, writes `generated/large-file-report.md`, which [24_amend_report.sh](#help-24_amend_report) inserts into the report.

[20_commit_code.sh](#help-20_commit_code) and [30_cleanup_aux.sh](#help-30_cleanup_aux) later copy `generated/dot-gitignore` over `.gitignore`.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/01_check_file_sizes.sh <directory> [tag]
```

- `directory` - Deposit directory (openICPSR ID, Zenodo ID, and so on) or another directory, such as restricted data.
- `tag` - Accepted for consistency with the other scripts; not used.

### Configuration

- `limitsize` in `config.yml` - Size limit in MB (default: 100).
